# StoreCensus

> StoreCensus is an ecommerce store intelligence platform that tracks Shopify, WooCommerce, and other online stores. It provides store data, app detection, technology intelligence, revenue estimates, and market research tools for agencies, SaaS companies, analysts, and B2B sales teams.

## Key Figures (as of 2026-11-05)

- Live Shopify stores tracked: 2,252,364
- Live WooCommerce stores tracked: 2,573,818
- All platforms: 4,884,522
- Shopify apps with at least one detected install: 4,161

## For AI Agents (MCP and API)

- MCP server: https://www.storecensus.com/api/mcp (Model Context Protocol, Streamable HTTP). Sign in with OAuth (discovery at https://www.storecensus.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/api/mcp, dynamic client registration, PKCE), or send the header "Authorization: Bearer <StoreCensus API key>". Included with Professional and above.
- MCP tools: search_stores (stores by country, vertical, revenue, apps installed / not installed / recently installed or removed, technologies, theme, Shopify plan and recent Plus upgrades, payments; count_only for market sizing), find_similar_stores (lookalikes of a store), get_store (one store's profile), unlock_store_contacts (emails and phones, uses credits), rank_apps (top, growing or declining apps in a category over 90 days), find_apps, get_app (installs now vs 30/90/365 days ago, pricing), find_technologies, list_app_categories, get_account (credits and daily usage).
- REST API documentation: https://www.storecensus.com/api
- Public data needs no key: per-app install statistics at https://www.storecensus.com/stats/app/{app-handle} and store profiles at https://www.storecensus.com/stores/{domain}

## Data Limitations

StoreCensus data is derived from public and technical signals. Revenue and traffic figures are directional estimates, not audited financial records. App detection accuracy varies by implementation. Coverage and confidence vary by store, platform, geography, and available signals. Users should verify critical decisions with their own research.
